result.description: A fictional tabletop office bindery unit designed for light-duty document finishing in small studios and home offices. It supports manual comb binding for up to 18 sheets per punch cycle, with a 210 mm paper width and an integrated waste tray. The enclosure is matte graphite polymer, and the machine is optimized for paper, covers, and dividers rather than any digital storage or graphics workload.
